lastcall AS (SELECT PRSCRBR_ME, MAX(CALL_DT) last_call FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRSCRBR_ME FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT WHERE CALL_DT > DATEADD(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date) AND CALL_DT <= '2026-09-30')
SELECT COUNT(*) hd_de, COUNT_IF(rc.PRSCRBR_ME IS NULL) uncalled, COUNT_IF(rc.PRSCRBR_ME IS NULL AND lc.PRSCRBR_ME IS NULL) never_called,

FROM hd LEFT JOIN rc ON rc.PRSCRBR_ME = hd.PRSCRBR_ME LEFT JOIN lastcall lc ON lc.PRSCRBR_ME=hd.PRSCRBR_ME
